The UI may look different with another theme or window size."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### ✏️ New Conversation Naming"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"**Name it before you create it.** Clicking `+` on a workspace title row opens a naming dialog instea"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"d of creating another “New Session”."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- Type a name and press Enter; **Skip naming** keeps the native one-click flow.
- The name is writte"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"n as the conversation title; before the first turn, the sidebar blank row shows it.
- Turn **Name ne"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"w conversations** off in the quick panel to restore the native behavior."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### 📎 File Drag Reference"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"**Drop a file, get a reference.** Open the **Files** tab in the right sidebar and drag a file or fol"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"der row into the composer:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- The composer shows **Drop to reference <name>**; on release it inserts an `@relative/path` chip.
-"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" The file is not moved, copied, or rewritten; the model reads it through its file tools when you sen"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"d.
- Paths are relative to the conversation workspace root; paths with spaces use `@"..."`.
- Folder"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"s are inserted with a trailing `/` (`@path/`) so the model can browse the directory.

- The branch keeps the earlier hi"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"story and title. The original is archived when archiving succeeds; otherwise it remains in the conve"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"rsation list.

The new conversation gets a new Session ID."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### 📍 Message Timeline"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"**Never lose your place in a long thread.** A thin fixed timeline sits on the right:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- One node per question/answer turn; each node is anchored on the user question and covers the assis"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"tant reply.
